TextView.android:text: TV Box Precision Mouse Click Fix
Fixes dropped clicks on Airtel Xstream & Set-top boxes when tapping search bars, buttons (e.g., PW.live, Google sign-in).
Prevents the Android TV soft keyboard from popping up when a physical keyboard is attached.
No PIN set (Set 4-digit PIN to enable)
Frees up internal TV storage and resets temporary web engine sessions.
